results.name: 1991 Republican Guard Command Desk
results.description: This specialized 3D asset represents the command desk of a Republican Guard officer during the pivotal 1991 resistance period in Arabia. The dark wood desk is marked with the official state emblem and serves as a tactical and symbolic hub. Laid across the surface is a standard-issue Tabuk assault rifle and the Holy Quran, signaling the immediate transition from administration to active combat. Accompanying the weaponry are nationalistic symbols of the era, including the Iraqi flag and personal effects, capturing the tense atmosphere of the Iraq War period between the Gulf War and the early 2000s.

results.name: Une gamelle comme souvenir
results.description:
**Gamelle règlementaire en aluminium de l'armée américaine avec couvercle - L. 22 ; l.17 (en cm).**

Arrivée en France avec les Boys en 1917, la gamelle modèle 1910 américaine est résolument différente des modèles connus en Europe. De forme ovale et plate, elle se compose d'une poêle et d'une assiette... en aluminium. De connotation négative, le terme "gamelle" a marqué des générations de conscrits pour lesquels elle fût le symbole même de la vie militaire. Pourtant, au même titre que les quarts, les gamelles ont souvent été personnalisées par leurs propriétaires (...). Le propriétaire de celle-ci a gravé sur le dessus son parcours en France pendant la Première Guerre mondiale en y ajoutant des symboles maçonniques.
(...).

[N° d’inv. 015.30.76. Collection Musée de la Résistance de Limoges (87-France)](https://collections-resistance.limoges.fr/fr/notice/015-30-76-gamelle-d24c2788-2c15-49c9-9b1f-9fdfb730feda)

results.name: Tipu's Tiger - A Mechanical Symbol of Resistance
results.description:
Tipu's Tiger is an 18th-century automaton, currently at the Victoria and Albert Museum, crafted to depict an Indian tiger attacking a European soldier. Commissioned by Tipu Sultan, a ruler of Mysore, India, the automaton features a crank-driven audio mechanism that simulates the sounds of the tiger's growls and the soldier's moans. Beyond its technological intrigue, it symbolizes Tipu Sultan's defiance against British colonialism.

This is a 3D scan created using Scaniverse.

results.name: Une gourde d’un soldat serbe
results.description:
**Flasque militaire en bois gravée par le soldat serbe Nikola Brcina pendant la 1ère Guerre mondiale
H. 20, L. 11, l. 6 (en cm).**

Gourde ornée sur le fût : des inscriptions serbes indiquent le parcours du soldat. Né en 1874 à Smom Robsgva, Nikola Brcina a combattu en Sardaigne à Sassari entre 1914 et 1916. La brigade mécanisée Sassari est créée le 1er mars 1915. La particularité de ces régiments est qu'ils ont été composés presque entièrement de Sardes et donc unis par un esprit de groupe. La retraite de l'armée serbe au cours de l'hiver 1915-1916 est gravée dans la mémoire collective sous le nom de « Golgotha albanais » : affamés, épuisés et pas équipés pour affronter l'hiver, toujours en proie aux attaques des clans albanais hostiles, plus de 200 000 soldats (parmi lesquels la moitié des recrues, soit 15 000 jeunes gens) et de civils reposent pour toujours dans les cols enneigés d'Albanie.

[N° d’inv. 010.27.1 Collection Musée de la Résistance de Limoges (87-France)](https://shorturl.at/enGO8)

results.name: Bronze Seahorse Vessel
results.description:
The Bronze Bowl supported by Seahorses is a part of the Queens College Anthropology Deparment Collection and was scanned by one of the Lab's interns using photogrammetry. 

Bronze is a copper alloy that is at least one-third tin, as it oxidizes and rusts the color turns green. The bowl itself was cast separately from the three seahorses and the four parts were later soldered, using a powder called solder that was melted between 2 pieces to stick them together. The indents on the Seahorses resemble the marking of incising, cutting in the a material to create a notch-like pattern, which was created by including prong-like pieces in the mold for the cast used to make the seahorses. The seahorse bowl is reminiscent of Chinese ashtray/ wood burners, as a similar bowl held by cranes was found to be from the Han Dynasty (although this vessel's provenance is unknown). Bronze's fire resistance indicates this vessel may have held something burning or fresh ash.

results.name: Miguel Malvar memorial - Philippines heritage
results.description:
Miguel Malvar y Carpio (September 27, 1865 – October 13, 1911) was a Filipino commander who fought in the Philippine Revolution and, later, the Philippine–American War. Following the surrender of resistance leader Emilio Aguinaldo by the Americans in 1901, he gained command of the Philippine revolutionary forces.

This statue is located in Santo Tomas, Batangas, Philippines.

58k tris, 8k textures diffuse/normal/metalness/roughness

results.name: Low-Poly Fp-45 Liberator
results.description:
The Liberator was a pistol developed during WW2 that was designed to be dropped from an aircraft into areas occupied by Nazi Germany. The pistol would then be picked up and used by resistance forces or an occupied civillian. It fired the .45 ACP round.

It's intended use was to allow individuals to gain access to a better weapon by killing a guard or lone enemy soldier.

There are few documented instances of the weapon being used as intended and most of the FP45's were destroyed after the war.
